I added a "Weather in Porto" card to the top of your Porto weekend page, but it doesn't show any weather yet. I can't fetch live weather from here, so I haven't seen it work. The card has a Refresh button. Tap it and the page asks your device for the current weather at Porto's coordinates, then shows the temperature and conditions with the time. The last reading is saved, so it's still there when you reopen the page.

The page needs your device's permission to read the weather, so you'll get a system prompt the first time. Because I haven't tested it, the temperature and conditions may not display in the format I expect. Your note text is unchanged. The previous version of the page is kept if you want to go back to it.
